review_scope: All 32 previously determinate ring scores; 93 existing indeterminate ring scores retained. Other traits revisited only where separating a ring from pigment variation was unresolved.

reasons.ring: A localized pale band encircles the throat, but its outer edge blends softly into violet tissue in both views. It does not meet the owner’s requirement for obvious Clear-ring edges.
A weak localized pale band is visible immediately outside the throat. Its outer boundary is soft rather than readily traceable, so it is Faint under the clarified rule.
Both views show weak localized paling immediately outside the orange throat. A band is visible, but its softly blended outer edge is insufficient for Clear.
A compact pale halo is visible outside the throat, but it blends into the surrounding pink tissue. The localized feature supports Faint rather than Clear.
The broad pale inner region grades gradually into the outer petals. The image does not establish where a separate ring would end and broad pigment variation would begin.
reasons.variation: The pale inner region cannot be separated confidently into a center ring versus broad pigment variation. Excluding it could produce a different score from including it; neither None nor Low/High is justified until that distinction is resolved.
